name: Fight_ApplyEvasionReductionToRos

If no crit override, total_ros = max(0, total_ros - reduction). | If total_ros reaches 0 and the action is not Laser/Beam and the defender lacks the related affinity bypass flag, set ZERO_ROS_TRIGGERED.

name: Fight_ApplyDefenseReductionToRos
